guard.note: loadPalette: one new BlockPos(III) per block entry (pos list ints 0, 1, 2), stored in its StructureBlockInfo (redirected, allow 1)
load: one new BlockPos(III) per entity entry (blockPos list), stored in its StructureEntityInfo (redirected, allow 1); the size is a Vec3i

vanilla_template_position_share.conversion: @Redirect of the new BlockPos(III) in StructureTemplate.loadPalette(HolderGetter, ListTag, ListTag) and in load(HolderGetter, CompoundTag) (entity block positions): a shared position from a table of every position 0..63, made in one go on first use in the order saved templates list their blocks (y, x, z), a new one otherwise
vanilla_template_position_share.license: Minecraft (Mojang): no-copy; the mixin carries only our own logic (helper bons.furious.patch.vanilla_template_memory.TemplatePositions)

guard.note: load: clears palettes and entityInfoList, one loadPalette per palette (palettes list) or one for palette, then the entity entries; RETURN injected
loadPalette: every block entry with its state from the palette, then palettes.add(new Palette(buildInfoList(...)))
buildInfoList: a new Lists.newArrayList() with the three sorted lists, the mutable list the trim removes from
Palette: final List blocks (accessor) and NeoForge's concurrent per-block cache filled lazily by blocks(Block), empty at load RETURN
loadFromResource: RESOURCE_LISTER.idToFile, then load(() -> resourceManager.open(file), error logger) -> readStructure -> StructureTemplate.load; HEAD / RETURN injected

vanilla_template_top_air_trim.conversion: @Inject HEAD/RETURN on StructureTemplateManager.loadFromResource(ResourceLocation) (ModernFix 5.27.24 does not replace it on 1.21.1) marks the thread; @Inject RETURN on StructureTemplate.load(HolderGetter, CompoundTag) removes, per palette, the air entries above the highest non-air block (room kept above the highest entity) from the palette's block list (accessor on blocks)
vanilla_template_top_air_trim.license: Minecraft (Mojang): no-copy; the mixins carry only our own logic (helper bons.furious.patch.vanilla_template_memory.TopAirTrim)
